best_hook.why: Catherine violently yanks the mother's locket off the restrained maid's neck; physical cruelty in the first second.

best_cliffhanger.why: Catherine reads the name and exposes her hidden identity, 'Lady Juliana Ashcroft'; the reveal lands and the consequences are unknown.

must_promos.why: Locket ripped away, 'gutter rat', heirloom thrown to the floor, villainess opens the mother's book and unmasks her as Lady Juliana Ashcroft; cut on the triumphant reveal.
Framed as a poisoner, then the Duchess rises to defend her and accuses Rupert and Catherine, only to collapse mid-sentence before she can finish.

standalone_risk: A stranger may not know Juliana is innocent unless the Duchess's defence is included, nor why the name reveal is dangerous (disgraced noble hiding as a maid) or what the herbarium is.
notes: Episode-ending gallows threat (B094-B095) is a strong alternative end point but cannot share a 60 s span with the locket hook.
